info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Mortgage Loans Documents-v1-spec
info.description: The Mortgage Loans Document Retrieval API enables users to efficiently access and retrieve important documents associated with mortgage loans. This API provides a structured way to obtain various types of loan documentation, such as contracts, disclosures, and statements. Typical consumers include mortgage brokers, lenders, and financial institutions that require quick access to loan-related documents for processing and compliance purposes. Utilizing this API streamlines the document management process, ensuring that stakeholders can easily find the necessary information to support mortgage transactions.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch documents related to loans, providing essential information for loan processing and management.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving loan documents. This body must be formatted as JSON and comply with the schema requirements specified. Ensure that you provide valid data in line with the expected structure.

200.description: The request was successful, and the loan documents are returned.
